# Terraform guard

Checks Terraform plans with checkov before apply.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add demo_opsbridge/opsbridge-marketplace
/plugin install terraform-guard@demo_opsbridge
```

# Plan Review

## Steps
1. Run terraform plan.
2. Run checkov.
3. Summarize risky changes.
